getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

ALLOC_LOW_BPS().notice: Share of the first-life manufacturing burden a second life relieves under energy allocation, 15-29% (Chalmers LCA of second-life Li-ion batteries).

CAT_DEMO().notice: A portable pack used to demonstrate the pipeline on real hardware. Portable batteries are outside the passport mandate; the label says so.

GRADE_TTL().notice: A grade older than this cannot authorise a repurposing.

MAX_INTERVAL_BPS().notice: Intervals wider than 10 points are too uncertain to act on.

MFG_G_PER_WH_LOW().notice: Cradle-to-gate emissions of new Li-ion cell production, 58-92 kg CO2e per kWh (Fraunhofer ISI). kg/kWh equals g/Wh, so these multiply Wh directly.

REPURPOSE_FLOOR_BPS().notice: Lower bound at or above 60%: fit for stationary second life.

REUSE_FLOOR_BPS().notice: Lower interval bound at or above 80% state of health: fit for reuse.

addRecycledContent(uint256,uint8,uint64).notice: Back part of a new battery's metal with spent recycled-metal notes.         Only for an original passport whose operator has not locked it.

closeAtRecycler(uint256,uint256).notice: Close a passport at a recycler's intake. One-way: a closed passport         can never feed a second batch. Returns its metal content.

deviceOf(uint256).notice: The device whose readings count for this passport, or zero unless         the passport is active. ReadingLog relies on that zero.

gradeFor(uint16,uint16).notice: The grading rule, public so anyone can check a grade.

meetsMinimum(uint256,uint8,bool).notice: Whether recycled content meets the Article 8 minimum for an element.         An element the battery does not contain is trivially compliant.

recordHealth(uint256,bytes32,bytes32,uin.notice: Record a health estimate. The grade is computed here from the         interval, not taken from the grader, and the estimate must cite an         anchored reading batch from this passport's own device.

repurpose(uint256,address,bytes32,uint8,.notice: Hand a pack over for a second life. Requires a fresh grade that         allows it. The child passport inherits the cells' metal content and         recycled content, and links back to the parent (Art. 77(6)).

revoke(uint256,bytes32).notice: Revoke a passport and every descendant. If a revoked battery was         recycled, the recycler batch it fed is tainted, which freezes any         recycled metal from that batch not yet handed out.

wire(address,address).notice: One-time wiring of the contracts deployed after this one.
